name: Interactive Brokers
description: Your Interactive Brokers account in OpenTrader through IB Gateway or TWS: balances, positions, orders and trading from the charts.

settings.label: Host
settings.help: The computer IB Gateway or TWS runs on. Keep 127.0.0.1 when it runs on this computer.

settings.label: Port
settings.help: The socket port set in the API settings of IB Gateway or TWS.

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Any number another API program connected to the same IB Gateway or TWS does not use.

setup:
In IB Gateway or TWS, log in, then open Configure > Settings > API > Settings:
1. Tick "Enable ActiveX and Socket Clients".
2. Check that "Socket port" matches the Port setting of the plugin (4002 for IB Gateway paper, 4001 live; 7497 for TWS paper, 7496 live).
3. Untick "Read-Only API" to trade from OpenTrader.
4. Keep "Allow connections from localhost only" ticked, or add 127.0.0.1 to the trusted IPs.
The plugin connects within a few seconds and retries while IB Gateway or TWS is closed. Then choose Trade > Connect broker > Interactive Brokers.
